title: Basic Column Projection and Row Limiting
realWorldScenario: The inventory operations team needs a quick glance at available catalog items to verify stock naming and retail pricing.
questionStatement: Write a query to retrieve the `name`, `category`, and `price` of all products from the `products` table, ordered alphabetically by `name`, limited to the first 5 records.
starterCode:
-- Select name, category, and price for the first 5 products
SELECT
  name,
  category,
  price
FROM products
ORDER BY name ASC
LIMIT 5;
hints: List the requested column names separated by commas.
Use ORDER BY name ASC to sort alphabetically.
Append LIMIT 5 at the end of the query.

testCases.description: Verify first 5 products in alphabetical order
